About.title: About Us
About.heading: A Farmer's Promise, Direct to You
About.body1: Aisaheb Agro Industries is run by Amol Sanjay Jadhav in Rashin, Tal. Karjat, Dist. Ahilyanagar. We grow, press, and grade our own oils and grains — no middlemen, no mixing.
About.body2: Every bottle of oil is cold-pressed to preserve its natural taste and nutrition. Every batch of grain is cleaned and graded by hand. When you order from us, you're buying directly from the farmer who grew it.
About.value2: Chemical Free — from farm to bottle
